doctrine_ref: v2 §2 gate 4 retention-window test (per event code); Master Plan §2 pillar D; deletion_rules.csv rule_12
rationale: Rule_12 retains only within the retention period. Past expiry, retention is over-retention and the record is no longer a permitted retained record; its exposed identifiers are a finding. Presence of an audit record must never be read as permission without the window check.
request_summary: Synthetic subject: a retained security audit record is past its retention_until date and still carries the subject's email address in its fields.
title: Over-retention: audit record past its retention window still carries identifiers
